meta.title: My Cellar, TERWA
meta.description: Track your Vintages, their release dates and your choices each time a vintage is made available.

title: My Cellar

connect.prompt: Connect your wallet to find your Vintages, their release dates and your upcoming choices.

error: Your cellar could not be loaded at the moment.

empty.title: Your cellar is empty
empty.body: Wine no. 1, Les Demoiselles from Château Coutet, is on pre-order: 1,660 Allocations, not one more.

card.footerNote: At each release: delivery to your door, free resale, or producer take-back.

actions.redeemSoon: repurchase opens once the producer funds are deposited
actions.redeemBody: The producer repurchases your {bottles} bottles of the {vintage} vintage, as per its repurchase commitment.
actions.redeemIrreversible: This operation is final: repurchased certificates are destroyed.
actions.redeemSuccess: Repurchase completed. The USDC is in your wallet.
actions.deliverBody: {bottles} bottles of the {vintage} vintage, in original wooden cases of 3. Proof of legal age is checked on receipt.
actions.deliverPrivacy: Your details are never published: only their fingerprint (hash) is recorded on-chain with your request.
actions.deliverSuccess: Delivery request received. Our logistics team will contact you to arrange delivery.
actions.panelQuestion: What would you like to do with this vintage?
actions.deliverDesc: Receive your bottles at home, in their original wooden cases.
actions.redeemDesc: The producer repurchases your bottles on request. Payment usually within 72 hours.
actions.sellDesc: Entrust the sale of your bottles to our dedicated service.
actions.sellModalBody: This service will open soon: it will let you entrust the sale of your bottles. Terms and conditions will be published before it opens.
actions.sellModalNote: In the meantime, your certificates remain freely transferable from wallet to wallet.
actions.redeemSettledNote: The producer funds are deposited: your repurchase can be executed immediately.
actions.requestBody: Repurchase is not automatic: your request is sent to the producer, who approves it and deposits the funds. You then confirm the repurchase here and receive the USDC in your wallet. Settlement usually takes about 72 hours; this timing is customary, never guaranteed.
actions.requestNote: Your request goes directly to our team, with your wallet address attached for identification. Nothing personal is published on-chain.
actions.requestQueueNote: Your request is signed with your wallet and joins our processing queue. Nothing personal is published on-chain.
actions.requestSent: Request sent. The producer usually responds within 72 hours, though this timing is never guaranteed.
actions.requestQueued: Request sent. The estate is being notified and usually settles within 72 hours, though this timing is never guaranteed. Track progress from My Cellar.
actions.sendFailed: Your details could not be transmitted automatically.

kyc.title: Identity verification

body.none: Purchasing is open to everyone. Verification will only be required on the way out: producer repurchase or delivery of your bottles.
body.pending: Your file is under review. No action is needed on your side.
body.approved: Your identity is verified: producer repurchase and delivery are open to this address.
body.rejected: Your file could not be validated. Write to us at contact@terwa.io so we can look at it together.

kyc.unavailable: Verification is opening soon. Please come back a little later.
kyc.failed: The verification service did not respond. Please try again.
kyc.sdkError: The verification module could not load. Close this window and try again.
kyc.allowlisted: Your address is enabled on-chain for repurchase and delivery.
kyc.allowlistPending: On-chain enablement of your address is in progress.

unlock.body: Confirm that you control this address to view your verification status and your requests. Your wallet signs a simple proof: nothing is published, nothing leaves your wallet.

repurchases.title: Repurchase requests
repurchases.empty: No repurchase request at the moment.
repurchases.note: The producer settles on request, usually within 72 hours. This timing is customary, never guaranteed.
repurchases.fundedHint: The producer funds are deposited: open the vintage above and confirm the repurchase to receive your USDC.
